canonical_scope: File nay la CANONICAL MACHINE-READABLE REGISTRY: runtime boundary engine, DB seed generator, evaluation va tests chi doc tu day. Khong runtime path nao duoc doc markdown de lay semantic con thieu.

field_ownership.note: Nhom thu nhat duoc tests/test_scenario_registry.py so khop nguoc voi bang Runtime-Revised Canonical Scenario Registry trong markdown (parity verification, khong phai runtime dependency). Nhom thu hai khong ton tai trong bang runtime cua markdown nen file nay la noi chot gia tri; moi khac biet voi derived view deu phai co entry trong divergence_resolutions.

divergence_resolutions.doc_reference: hr_interaction_boundary_plan.md :: Canonical Scenario Registry - Deprecated Design History (cot sensitivity); Revised Employee Boundary Matrix V2
divergence_resolutions.rationale: Bang runtime khong so huu cot sensitivity. Derived view (design history) de gia tri kep khong enum hoa duoc. Chot High: scenario nay la WFH exception do HRBP quyet dinh va derived view cam thu thong tin y te chi tiet, tuc thuoc nhom can bao ve cao hon.

divergence_resolutions.derived_view_value: Ma case neu co, nhu cau hoi quy trinh
divergence_resolutions.doc_reference: hr_interaction_boundary_plan.md :: PII And Security Classification (hang 'ER critical')
divergence_resolutions.rationale: Field 'nhu cau hoi quy trinh' cua mot case ky luat thuoc nhom ER critical theo bang PII, khong the dung chung field question_summary (Medium) voi cac scenario lifecycle. Day la field rieng duoc phan loai theo dung bang PII, khong phai ha/nang sensitivity cua scenario.
